de0cc68ab9397af1.description: Job description Location: Riyadh, Saudi ArabiaThales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.For over 50 years, Thales has been a trusted partner of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. As a local industrial partner, Thales provides advanced solutions in Defence, Public Security, Civil Aviation, Space, Enterprise, and Cybersecurity across four sites throughout the country. The Saudi Vision 2030 is at the heart of Thales' strategy in the Kingdom, driving the localisation of defence technologies and systems, strengthening local capabilities, developing local talent, and supporting national sovereignty through strategic collaborations. To reinforce its commitment to localising its defence activities and to build a future we can trust in the Kingdom, Thales established SAMI Thales Electronic Systems (STES), a Joint Venture with Saudi Arabian Military Industries (SAMI), operating under the ambitious directives outlined in Vision 2030. JOB OBJECTIVE Support and monitor all data processing activities to ensure accurate, secure, and efficient operations, while maintaining reliable equipment performance, minimizing downtime, and supporting continuous improvement in compliance with operational, safety, and quality standards. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Effectively communicate any product or data processing issues at the daily production briefings. First line incident support for any personalization and infrastructure issues. process customer test cycle (SAT/UAT) submissions ensuring SLAs are met. Change request notification administration. provide technical support and advice to other operational departments and teams. Diagnose and repair electrical, mechanical, and electromechanical equipment faults. Execute preventive and corrective maintenance tasks according to maintenance schedules. Report all equipment issues, breakdowns, and recurring faults to the Maintenance Manager in a timely and clear manner. Use technical drawings, manuals, and diagnostic tools to perform maintenance activities accurately. Support machinery installation, commissioning, and upgrades. Respond effectively to emergency breakdowns to minimize production downtime. Ensure compliance with safety procedures, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and company policies. Record maintenance activities, spare parts usage, and equipment condition accurately. Coordinate with engineers and supervisors to resolve complex technical issues. Support root-cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions. WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS Above 5 years QUALIFICATION, CERTIFICATION & EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS Proven experience or relevant qualifications in IT support, equipment maintenance, or a related technical role. PREFERRED SKILLS Knowledge of HTML,CSS, Javascript and SQL would be advantageous. Have a good competence level of Microsoft OS and office suite applications. Have strong logical and analytical skills with high attention to detail. Hands-on experience with industrial machinery and production equipment. Strong troubleshooting skills using electrical and mechanical diagnostic tools. Knowledge of safety standards and maintenance best practices. Ability to work under pressure and respond effectively to emergency situations. Good teamwork and collaboration skills across maintenance, engineering, and operations teams. Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and equipment. Attention to detail and commitment to accurate documentation. Comply with local HSE laws and legislation. To use safety equipment (including PPE) as required and intended. In this circumstance, such conditions must be reported immediately to their line manager and the HSE department. At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now! The successful candidate will combine creative leadership, technical expertise, commercial awareness, project management, and excellent client-facing skills. This is a senior, hands-on role for a confident leader who can inspire teams, manage demanding stakeholders, make effective decisions under pressure, and ensure projects are delivered to the highest standards, on time, and within budget. Role location: Riyadh, KSA Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary design team, setting clear responsibilities, priorities, and performance standards. Establish the creative direction for projects and maintain the design vision throughout all stages of development and delivery. Manage multiple complex projects, including scope, schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, risks, and quality. Act as the primary senior contact for clients, building strong relationships and managing expectations professionally. Lead client meetings, workshops, presentations and design-approval sessions. Translate client requirements and feedback into clear, practical actions for the design and project teams. Provide creative and technical guidance while remaining hands-on during critical project stages. Coordinate with consultants, contractors, suppliers, production teams, and other project stakeholders. Ensure designs are creative, functional, technically accurate, commercially viable, and compliant with relevant standards. Manage design changes and communicate their impact on scope, fees, schedules, and resources. de792534b97e7444.description: Job description POSITION SUMMARY Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. License or Certification: None At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law. We invite you to join us today. In joining EDITION, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on driving brand growth, distribution, visibility, and in-store execution, working closely with Sales, Category, and other internal teams to enhance the performance of the company's own brands. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute trade marketing strategies specifically for the company’s private label brands. de8524bfa3f15c2c.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is an integrated AEP/PMCM firm known for its end-to-end services in planning, design, and project delivery within the built and natural environments. With over 57 years of experience, KEO has contributed to significant projects globally. The firm is recognized by ENR in the Top 225 International Design Firms and Top 20 International PM/CM Firms, and by World Architecture as the 50th largest global architecture firm and #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2021 WAS 100 Survey. The Role: Civil & Finishing Inspector KEO International Consultants is seeking a Civil & Finishing Inspector to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience. The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure proper communication with client site engineers on all project-related matters and to review, understand, and implement contract drawings and specifications on site. Key Responsibilities Inspect and monitor civil, architectural, and finishing works to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, project requirements, and KEO standards. Conduct regular site inspections to verify the quality, workmanship, and progress of architectural and civil works. Inspect architectural finishes, including flooring, tiling, wall finishes, ceilings, painting, plastering, joinery, doors, windows, and waterproofing. Monitor civil works, including blockwork, plastering, screed, waterproofing, and concrete-related works. Review approved shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and inspection and test plans. Ensure construction activities adhere to approved drawings, specifications, approved materials, and applicable standards. Identify defects, non-conformances, and workmanship issues, ensuring corrective actions are implemented and closed out. Witness inspections and testing activities in accordance with approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs). Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and other disciplines to resolve technical and construction-related issues. Review and comment on RFIs, shop drawings, material submissions, and other relevant technical documentation. Monitor the quality and progress of civil and architectural finishing works, reporting concerns to the project team. Ensure proper coordination between architectural finishes, civil, structural, MEP, and other building services. Maintain accurate records of inspections, observations, non-conformances, and site activities. Participate in site meetings, inspections, snagging, rectification, and handover activities. Inspect completed works during snagging and handover stages to ensure all outstanding works and defects are addressed. Ensure works comply with applicable Saudi Arabian regulations, project specifications, approved drawings, and relevant international standards. Support the project team in maintaining required quality standards throughout the construction process. Ensure compliance with project health, safety, and environmental requirements during site activities. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a talented Civil/Finishes Inspector with 8-10 years of experience in architecture-related inspection roles. Success in this position requires a strong understanding of contract drawings and specifications, along with the ability to effectively communicate and coordinate with various project stakeholders. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working on-site and collaborating with project teams, contractors, and consultants to ensure project quality and compliance. Application Process KEO International Consultants invites qualified candidates to apply for this opportunity. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

de42a89ba1712d4f.description: Qiddiya Investment Company, a key driver of Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030, is developing a world-class entertainment, cultural, and lifestyle destination that demands robust strategic supplier partnerships. As the project evolves, ensuring excellence in supplier relationship management is crucial to the success and sustainability of this giga project. We are looking for a highly experienced and visionary Manager – Strategic Supplier Relationship Management to lead and elevate the SRM function to greater levels of sophistication and impact. This senior leadership role will oversee the strategic direction, execution, and continuous improvement of the SRM program, fostering innovation, resilience, and value creation across the supply chain network. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in managing complex supplier ecosystems and driving cross-functional collaboration to realize strategic business outcomes. Key Responsibilities : 1. Leadership and Strategic Direction · Define and champion the enterprise-wide SRM strategy in alignment with corporate objectives and Vision 2030 goals. · Provide thought leadership on supplier engagement, risk mitigation, and governance frameworks at senior executive levels. · Drive cultural transformation to embed strategic SRM practices throughout the organization. 2. Program Oversight and Continuous Improvement · Lead the design, implementation, and evolution of SRM frameworks, policies, and tools to ensure industry best practices. · Oversee supplier segmentation, risk assessments, performance measurement, and business continuity planning. · Ensure integration of SRM initiatives with procurement, risk, legal, finance, and operational functions. 3. Supplier Relationship Leadership · Develop and maintain executive-level relationships with strategic suppliers to drive innovation and mutual value. · Guide cross-functional teams in executing joint business plans and strategic initiatives with key suppliers. · Address complex supplier performance, risk, and compliance issues with balanced leadership. 4. Stakeholder Engagement and Governance · Facilitate executive forums such as Quarterly Business Reviews and SRM steering committees. · Influence and advise senior leaders to adopt consistent SRM governance models and decision frameworks. · Champion transparency, accountability, and data-driven decision-making across the supplier ecosystem. 5. Team Development and Capability Building · Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing SRM team, fostering collaboration and professional growth. · Promote skill development initiatives and succession planning within the team. 6. Value Creation and Innovation · Drive initiatives that leverage supplier partnerships to deliver cost efficiencies, service excellence, and sustainability benefits. · Champion ESG and digital transformation efforts aligned with organizational strategy. Qualifications: · 12+ years of relevant experience including strategic supplier relationship management, procurement, supply chain management, or related fields in complex and multinational environments. · Advanced degree such as MBA or Master’s in Supply Chain, Business Administration, or related discipline preferred. · Relevant professional certifications such as CPSM, CSCP, or CPM are highly desirable. · Proven ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders and suppliers at executive levels. · Strong leadership, negotiation, and communication skills. · Experience in giga projects or large-scale developments is an advantage. Comprehensive benefits package

In this capacity, you will manage cash flow, funding strategies, and risk assessments to support the company's strategic objectives. Develop cash flow forecasts and monitor liquidity positions to ensure adequate funding for operational needs. Manage banking relationships, negotiate terms, and ensure effective execution of financial transactions. Perform financial risk analysis related to interest rates, foreign exchange, and investment portfolios. Implement and maintain treasury policies and procedures to optimize financial performance and compliance. Assist in developing and executing investment strategies to maximize returns while managing risk. Prepare detailed reports and presentations for senior management on treasury performance and market conditions. Collaborate with various departments to align financial activities with organizational objectives.
